principles.principle: Prefer screenshot-based verification over assumption-based debugging. If you cannot confirm the page state visually, you are guessing.
Prefer the smallest change that satisfies the debugging request. Do not refactor or rewrite code unless it directly addresses the bug.
Prefer a single source of truth for debugging evidence. All screenshots, console logs, and network activity go into the evidence/ directory with structured documentation.
Ask a clarifying question only when critical ambiguity remains. If the user's bug report is clear, proceed with the planned workflow.

boundaries.rule: This mode handles web debugging via browser automation. It does NOT handle: - Server-side debugging (use Debug mode) - Database query debugging (use Debug mode) - Unit test writing (use test-writer mode) - Performance profiling without visual debugging (use a dedicated mode)

handoff.trigger: Root cause is identified as a server-side issue (API not returning expected data, server crash, database query failure).
handoff.action: Document the evidence collected, then switch to Debug mode for server-side investigation.

handoff.trigger: The fix requires modifying source code, not just identifying the bug.
handoff.action: Provide the Code mode with: - Evidence summary (what was found) - Screenshot paths showing the bug - Console logs and network activity - Suggested fix approach

handoff.trigger: The debugging session reveals multiple issues spanning different domains (UI, API, database) that require coordinated fixes.
handoff.action: Provide a summary of all findings and hand off for multi-mode coordination.

validation.rule: After completing a debugging session, scan the evidence directory for completeness: every action step should have a screenshot pair (before/after).
Update examples in 5_examples.xml when you discover a new debugging pattern that isn't already documented.
Ensure the evidence.md file is structured and self-contained so that another developer (or another mode) can understand the findings without re-running the session.
If the debugging session was inconclusive, document what was ruled out so the next investigator doesn't repeat the same steps.

At the end of every session, generate two task lists: 1. Workspace-level: Update the project TODO list with any follow-up work discovered during debugging (e.g., fix data permissions, add favicon). 2. Handoff-level: Append a structured task list to evidence.md that can be passed to a new chat for continuation. This must include the URL, session state, evidence paths, and remaining work sorted by priority.

After any visual debugging session, validate accessibility and human readability:
All text passes WCAG AA contrast ratio (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text) If any text fails, add to task list with specific contrast ratio and suggested fix
Effective contrast accounts for opacity (raw contrast × opacity ≥ 4.5) Report both raw and effective contrast in evidence
Font sizes are ≥ 14px with line-height ≥ 1.4 Flag text below thresholds as readability issues
Color-only status indicators pass deuteranopia simulation Flag color-only indicators that fail
Layout alignment, typography hierarchy, and border/shadow consistency are visually polished Document specific failures with screenshot evidence
Mobile verification completed at all breakpoints (375x667, 768x1024, 1280x720) Include mobile screenshots and touch target validation in evidence

Visual polish is a pass/fail gate — not optional:
Any body text with effective contrast < 3:1 Any body text with font size < 12px Margin inconsistency > 20px between similar elements h1 ≤ h2 or h2 ≤ h3 in font size Text truncation without ellipsis on visible elements Touch targets < 44x44px on mobile

scenario.name: page_navigation
scenario.description: Need to navigate to a specific URL
scenario.why: Direct navigation with wait control. Use 'networkidle' for full load.
scenario.pitfall: Avoid using page.reload() for initial navigation; it assumes already loaded.

scenario.name: element_interaction
scenario.description: Need to click, type, or interact with a page element
scenario.recommended_tool: Playwright locator API (getByRole, getByText, getByTestId, locator)
scenario.why: Auto-waits for element to be actionable. More reliable than raw selectors.
scenario.pitfall: Avoid page.$eval or page.$$eval for interaction — they don't auto-wait. Use locator.click() instead of page.evaluate(() => el.click()).

scenario.name: state_extraction
scenario.description: Need to read page state (DOM content, computed styles, console logs)
scenario.recommended_tool: page.evaluate() for DOM/content; page.on('console') for logs
scenario.why: page.evaluate() runs in browser context with full API access.
scenario.pitfall: Do not use page.evaluate() to perform actions (clicks, form fills). Use locator API for actions, evaluate only for reading.

scenario.name: screenshot_capture
scenario.description: Need to capture visual state of the page
scenario.why: Built-in, captures exactly what the browser renders.
scenario.pitfall: fullPage: true for full-page screenshots; omit for viewport-only. Use element.screenshot() for individual element captures. Headless screenshots may differ from headed; use headed for visual debugging.

scenario.name: network_debugging
scenario.description: Need to inspect API requests and responses
scenario.why: Captures all network activity without modifying behavior.
scenario.pitfall: For request modification, use page.route() with handler. For passive monitoring, use event listeners only.

stop_conditions.condition: Stop and ask a clarifying question when: - The target URL is ambiguous (multiple possible URLs) - Credentials are needed and not provided - The bug description is too vague to plan a session - Multiple debugging approaches are equally valid

Stop and document as inconclusive when: - The bug does not reproduce after 3 attempts with clean state - Console and network show no anomalies but visual differs from expectations - The page requires authentication that cannot be provided - The bug is intermittent and not reliably reproducible
